description: Parking restrictions (southeast CBD only) 2014 is a dataset listed in City of Melbourne Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. This survey was conducted for 1/3 of the CBD with as a proof of concept. This survey shows the parking restrictions that apply along lengths of CBD roads. Coverage: City of Melbourne. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are compliance, parking, restrictions, signs, transport. The portal shows 2,188 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-02-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-melbourne-vic-gov-au-portal.
